title: Michigan’s free community college shuts out rural universities. They want in
summary_en: Four rural-based universities that offer associate degrees are lobbying for expansion of the Community College Guarantee, the state’s free tuition program. Some say it would be costly. Proponents say it would serve all students, especially those in community college “deserts.”
author: Kim Kozlowski
